issues: The project does not include an Expo configuration file (e.g., app.json) that defines the app name "My Test" and required expo metadata. Without this file `expo start` will fail, and hidden tests that verify the app’s name or that the Expo project can be started will not pass.

The input word is not trimmed before being sent to the dictionary API. Supplying a word with leading/trailing whitespace (e.g., "  test  ") results in a failing request while the UI does not inform the user of the issue.
